function.name: submit_triage_report
function.description: Submits a standardized clinical intake summary to the health center's provider dashboard after completing conversational symptom triage.

chief_complaint.description: Primary symptom or reason for contacting the health center (e.g., 'Persistent fatigue and afternoon weakness').

duration_and_onset.description: Timeline of symptoms, including onset date and progression (e.g., 'Gradual onset over past 3 weeks, worsening in afternoons').

symptom_details.description: Detailed clinical characteristics: severity, functional impact, alleviating/aggravating factors, and pertinent negatives (e.g., 'Reports lightheadedness on standing; denies fever, chills, cough, or chest pain').

relevant_history_notes.description: Correlation between current symptoms and existing records/labs (e.g., 'Symptoms mirror February 2026 iron deficiency presentation; ferritin was 11 ng/mL').

escalation_level.description: Clinical urgency tier based on reported symptoms and red flag presence.

suggested_provider_action.description: Suggested non-binding clinical follow-up for the provider to consider (e.g., 'Evaluate for repeat CBC/ferritin panel; review oral iron compliance').
